testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, hymn list items, and admin controls MUST include kebab-case role-based data-testid (e.g., data-testid='hinos-da-semana-tab', data-testid='add-hymn-button', data-testid='whatsapp-link-member-1')
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_rules: APCA 4.5:1 ratio minimum for body text against dark backgrounds. Solid non-transparent dropdowns and overlays.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the full Banda El Shaday platform in Portuguese (pt-BR).
Keep CSS variables for palette so the band can easily inject their official logo colors later.
Ensure both public view and authenticated/admin views are seamless and rich with features.
Include mock seed data for Hinos da Semana, Playlists with real working YouTube & Spotify embed URLs, and Aniversariantes.
Make sure all interactive buttons have explicit data-testid attributes.
